facts.text: Product: Sleepyhead Sofa Yolo – 3 Seater LHS L Shape Sofa Set (Fabric, Sesame Grey).
Selected variant is Sesame Grey / LHS.
The upholstery is a polyester and polypropylene fabric blend.
The fabric is 320 GSM, with 65.1% polyester and 34.9% polypropylene.
Listed dimensions are 262.5 cm × 160 cm × 89 cm (length × depth × height).
The sofa has a solid wood frame.
The back is fixed and tufted.
Cushioning consists of three layers: HR foam, a supersoft layer and outer padding.
